pos.personaBrief: Leicester 2015/16 had 42.43% possession, the lowest of any PL champion, and Ranieri said he would not force possession football on a team that cannot keep the ball. Play was built on transitions with fast forwards.

pro.personaBrief: Schmeichel almost always went long, and Leicester wanted the ball far from goal. Counters reached the box in few passes, with diagonals to Mahrez.

est.personaBrief: A fixed 4-4-2 / 4-4-1-1 in 35 of 38 games, with a stable XI and zonal compactness, so defined roles. Mahrez drifted inside and Okazaki dropped as a deep striker, but this was a disciplined shape rather than relational play.

lar.personaBrief: A standard English 4-4-2 with wingers, where Albrighton went wide and Mahrez cut inside. Play was often switched wide or went diagonal, with two banks of four and no extra central midfielder.

blo.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung describes a mid-low block with three close lines, and the team pressed only when the ball went wide. It did not press the build-up from the first pass, and it dropped off against sides that played out well.

mar.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung describes a zonal marking system with man-orientations, with wingers not tracking full-backs. Ranieri was Sacchi-influenced and used no dedicated marker on stars in the evidence.

pla.personaBrief: He kept the same 4-4-2 and counter plan in 35 of 38 matches, built around his players' traits rather than imposing a model. He studied opponents closely, but his own shape stayed stable and he did not change at half-time.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic: five 1-0 wins in six games, lowest possession of a champion, and he said he would not play possession football at the risk of conceding. Results came before aesthetics.

sis.personaBrief: A compact collective with a near-fixed XI, where Vardy and Mahrez had defined roles. Everyone worked in the system, and Ranieri said he built the team around his players' characteristics.

jog.personaBrief: Pace and work rate (Vardy, Okazaki), hard running, and Kante's league-high tackles and interceptions defined the team. Physical intensity was central, though Drinkwater and Mahrez added technique.

bas.personaBrief: A cheap squad of experienced, proven players, with stability and no academy emphasis. Signings were bought rather than developed, and a near-fixed XI of veterans won the title.

lid.personaBrief: Calm, relaxed and trust-based: a pact with the players, two days off each week, title talk filtered out, and 'I would speak very little of tactics'. He kept firm calm authority, but harmony came first.
